name: favmov

scripts.setup: pnpm --dir backend install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir frontend install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir e2e install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.test: pnpm --dir backend test && pnpm --dir frontend test
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir backend lint && pnpm --dir backend format:check && pnpm --dir frontend lint && pnpm --dir frontend format:check && pnpm --dir e2e lint && pnpm --dir e2e format:check
scripts.format: pnpm --dir backend format && pnpm --dir frontend format && pnpm --dir e2e format

description: Browse movies, TV shows and people, and save titles in personal collections with notes.
